messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: Reported by <@519965006867988490> in staff chat: the Iron Dome info on screen says it costs 6t of components, but building one takes 60t every time.

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@519965006867988490> the province page showed the dome resource costs as a raw number (6,000) instead of tonnes like everywhere else, which looked like 6 but it's really 6t per dome. i made it show proper units. i couldn't find anything charging 60t though, the build takes 6t components, 20t steel and 8t aluminium per dome. if you still see 60t taken after building one dome, tell me your before/after component amounts and how many you built. should be live within the hour

title: Iron Dome says 6t components but charges 60t
